claims.claim_text: Support for ongoing reconciliation efforts in Cyprus.
Support for ongoing reconciliation efforts in Northern Ireland, including appointing a U.S. special envoy.
Americans and Russians share an imperative to end terrorism.
Americans and Russians share an imperative to combat nuclear proliferation.
Americans and Russians share an imperative to promote bilateral trade.
The momentum of Middle Eastern change is evaluated as moving in the right direction.
Middle Eastern countries that had made peace with Israel, formally or in practice, deserved U.S. appreciation and assistance.
